name: Ear Olympics
author: asilagy
tagline: a WarioWare-style ear-training arcade for the FM-1
description: Ear Olympics turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a fast ear-training arcade, run by a cat called Meow. In Copycat you hear a root note and a melody over it and play the melody back by ear. Levels rise as you get things right, and every mistake plays the right answer so you learn from it. More skills and a shuffled arcade mode are on the way.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
